**Claude Code is assignment mein kaafi kaam aayega**, kyunki jo cheezein maangi gayi hain unme se zyada iske andar hi built-in hain:

| Assignment ki requirement | Claude Code mein kaise hoga |
|---|---|
| Skills | `.claude/skills/` mein custom skills ban jaati hain |
| Hooks (same format ka output) | `settings.json` mein hooks lagte hain, jaise PostToolUse aur Stop |
| AI interaction log | Hooks se har prompt aur tool call ek log file mein automatically likha ja sakta hai |
| Agents aur sub-agents | `.claude/agents/` mein agents define karo, jaise spec-writer, implementer, test-writer, reviewer |
